localized.description: Text shown to visitors. Either one string for every language, or an object keyed by language code. Missing languages fall back to the default language.

page.description: Slug of a page in content/pages, for example "find-a-grave" or "services/commemoration". Empty string is the home page.

anchor.description: Optional section id on that page.

href.description: External link. Use instead of page.

label.description: Optional. Defaults to the page title.

sourceId.description: Id of the matching entry in content/sources.json

rule.description: When a yearly service falls. pascha:N (days from Orthodox Pascha), church:MM-DD (fixed feast on the church calendar), saturdayBefore:MM-DD, sundayAfter:MM-DD, or date:YYYY-MM-DD for a one-time event.
